lineage_selection.note: permutation p-values of the lineage share; the smallest attainable p-value is 1/(n_perm + 1), so a panel of m agents needs n_perm large enough that this floor is below alpha/m for a single agent to be selectable
lineage_selection.resolution_note: with 150 permutations one agent alone cannot be selected among 18 at alpha = 0.05; at least 1258 permutations would let a single very small p-value pass the step-up

lineage_evidence.note: e-value in the betting sense of Vovk and Wang, not the BLAST expectation value and not the E-value of VanderWeele and Ding
